name: file-upload-04
title: File Upload Drag & Drop
description: A file upload drag & drop block.

standards.purpose: Get a file from the user's device into the product with clear limits and progress.
useWhen: The user supplies a document, image, or archive.
doNotUseWhen: The data is short structured text that belongs in a form field.

rules.check: Accepted types and size limits are stated before the user selects a file.
Upload progress and completion are announced to assistive tech.
A failed upload states the reason and offers retry without losing the other files.
The file input has an accessible label and works from the keyboard.
